heading: Maintenance Plans
intro: Carolina Heating Service's maintenance plan, Carolina Comfort Club, offers a solid option for ensuring the longevity and reliable operation of your heating and cooling systems. With a tune-up, 15% repair discount, reduced dispatch fees, and priority service, this plan guarantees peak efficiency, cost savings, extended lifespan, comfort, and warranty maintenance.
planIntro: Our comprehensive maintenance plan ensures peak performance, cost savings, extended lifespan, and priority service for your heating and cooling systems.

benefits.title: 15% Off Any Repair Including Parts & Labor
benefits.body: Save on repair costs with Carolina Comfort Club, ensuring unexpected breakdowns won't break the bank. Enjoy peace of mind with our 1-year labor warranty on all repairs—because quality service should last.

benefits.title: Heating & Cooling Tune-Up
benefits.body: Keep your HVAC system running efficiently and prevent costly issues with 2 tune-ups annually from Carolina Heating's Maintenance Plan.

benefits.title: Reduced Dispatch Fees
benefits.body: Enjoy discounted dispatch fees as a valued member of Carolina Comfort Club. (Members only pay $99 versus $149 for Non-Members)

benefits.title: Priority Service
benefits.body: Receive top priority attention and fast response times with the Carolina Comfort Club, ensuring your comfort is never compromised.

benefits.title: Loyalty Pays Off
benefits.body: Earn $50 in credits every year you renew (up to $500) to put toward a brand-new system when you're ready to upgrade!

benefits.title: Flexible & Affordable
benefits.body: Choose a monthly membership for as low as $24/month, and enjoy your first month FREE when you sign up for monthly billing!
